trigger_accuracy.label: Trigger Accuracy
trigger_accuracy.description: Requests activate the appropriate dddjango skill behavior without contaminating unrelated tasks.

drf_rejection.label: DRF Rejection
drf_rejection.description: DRF requests are redirected to Django Ninja without generating DRF code.

django_ninja_api.label: Django Ninja API
django_ninja_api.description: API outputs use Django Ninja Router, Schema, response mappings, and the dddjango error standard.

ddd_boundaries.label: DDD Boundaries
ddd_boundaries.description: Domain boundaries, aggregate rules, value objects, and domain services are placed outside routers and views.

db_transaction.label: DB/Transaction
db_transaction.description: Database constraints, indexes, transaction boundaries, locking, and idempotency are handled explicitly.

tdd_pytest.label: TDD/Pytest
tdd_pytest.description: TDD requests produce RED/GREEN/REFACTOR flow and pytest cases for normal, boundary, failure, and idempotency behavior.

clean_implementation.label: Clean Implementation
clean_implementation.description: Outputs are maintainable, typed, explicit about errors, and avoid unnecessary abstraction.

review_refactor.label: Review/Refactor
review_refactor.description: Review outputs identify high-impact issues and connect fixes to dddjango principles.

subagent_workflow.label: Subagent Workflow
subagent_workflow.description: Composite work is decomposed into roles with handoff contracts and sequential fallback.

reference_usage.label: Reference Usage
reference_usage.description: Specific rules from dddjango references appear in the output when relevant.

usability.label: Usability
usability.description: Korean-first answers are concrete, runnable, and clear about unexecuted validation.
